subject: world_language
concept: Applying hypothetical structures, academic vocabulary, idioms, and extended discussion together in a combined real-world scenario
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences a combined scenario drawing on this unit's full skill set

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
